pages.text: By default a maid turns into a ragdoll when:$(li)she is killed;$(li)her owner hits her with a weapon the mod listens to;$(li)she is let out of a maid cake box.$(br2)Two more cases are off by default: bumping into a broom, and taking damage of a configurable type.

As a ragdoll she is a physics object. She slides down slopes, tumbles when hit, and can be pushed by other ragdolls, players, mobs and sub-level machines. Ragdolls that slam into something at speed also play an impact sound.$(br2)Breaking a single part destroys the entire ragdoll and restores the maid.
